claim: Postman files use Collection Format v2.1.0, whose schema is https://schema.getpostman.com/json/collection/v2.1.0/collection.json (every generated file validated against it on 2026-11-06).
In Postman, open your workspace, click Use resources or import, select the Import tab, and drop the file in or paste its URL.
quote: Select your file or folder, drag it into the import window, or paste raw text or a URL.

claim: Postman imports a dropped file (the collection can be dragged straight in).
quote: You can also drag and drop files or folders directly into Postman.

claim: In Bruno, click the + button and select Import Collection.
quote: Click the + button in the top-left corner and select Import Collection

claim: Choose Bruno Collection and select the unzipped folder.
quote: Browse and select your Bruno collection folder

claim: Bruno also imports the Postman file directly.
quote: Drag and drop your exported .json file, or click to browse

claim: A Bruno collection is a folder of plain-text .bru files, one per request.
quote: The API requests in your collections are stored as plain text files using this language.
